decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, so with its own R&D and university cooperation the firm can interpret early results and refine the product.
The air cooled condenser builds directly on established air-cooled heat exchange expertise and testing facilities, giving the firm high absorptive capacity to improve it.

Although it overlaps with Product B, this condenser is close to the core offer and supports the firm's efficiency and waste-heat agenda, so the firm is likely to keep and refine it rather than drop it.
The tube liner extends the firm's lifecycle service business on the basis of deep tube and corrosion knowledge, making early field results easy to assimilate.
The customized industrial air cooler line matches the firm's strategy of integrated custom solutions and draws on core engineering knowledge.
The tube end repair inserts build on established repair and service expertise and fit the firm's broad service support model.
